Implement one acceptance criterion from the requested user story using TDD.

1. Restate the observable behavior in Given/When/Then terms.
2. Add the smallest failing test in the owning service.
3. Implement only enough production code to pass it.
4. Run the focused test, then the relevant full suite.
5. Add or update an Alembic migration when persistence changes.
6. Report remaining acceptance criteria without implementing them implicitly.
